findings.text: the reviewed commit changes only this file, which is outside the node's declared write paths and outside the promotion suite template's arms, so its assertions run only in the ad-hoc importer sweep whose head log exits 1 on 17 pre-existing failures; promotion therefore cannot read a green gate for the one file this commit changed, and the fix is to wire coordinator-authorised paths into the fence and the suite template rather than to change this test.

item_verdicts.call_sites: reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:836-864 renders the duty lines and their collapse on a shared next_command, and reckon/crew/obligations.py:2090-2100 plus reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:2521 compose the per-run command the test asserts.
item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit fc1f463060 against 96689ac036: one file, +12/-16, renaming and rewriting one test, its docstring and one helper docstring, with no other change.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks a test proving one counted run is one listed run with its promote command, a negative control that restores the separate count, and no added failure in the files importing the changed modules; the reviewed commit's own gate is recorded in the importer arms at /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261112T065943474159-wave1-a2-the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watche-s87/logs/importers_{base,head}.log (17 failed on each, identical id sets) plus head_arm.log EXIT=0, and I re-ran tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py at fc1f463060 for 17 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that every unreconciled run is an obligation with a remedy; the reviewed increment fc1f463060 re-points tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py at the per-run remedy that 96689ac036 landed, so the test now asserts 'reckon crew complete --run <id>' rather than the run-less command it pinned before.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reads status complete, names both commits, records the base and head arms with their log paths and EXIT=0, discloses the 17-failure importer arms as identical between revisions with comm empty on both sides, and records the hook test's re-pointing and its 17 passes in failure_attribution.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node was fenced to reckon/crew/obligations.py, tests/test_obligation_count_equals_its_list.py, the evidence fragment and its figures dir; the reviewed commit changes only tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py, outside that list, which the manifest's scope_note records as written on the coordinator's explicit instruction after the earlier review and which this dispatch was raised to review.

justifications.durability: reinstating the run-less command at reckon/crew/obligations.py:2090-2100 makes both duties share one next_command, so reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:840-859 collapses them to one '- [review-ready] 2 items' line and the test fails on len(review) == 2 at tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py:822; were the collapse removed, len(commands) == 2 at :825 and the literal check at :830 fail instead.
justifications.evidence: the changed file is in the importer head arm's command (/tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261112T065943474159-wave1-a2-the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watche-s87/logs/importers_head.log:2) and is absent from both arms' 17 FAILED ids, but the promotion pair's arms name only tests/test_obligation_count_equals_its_list.py and tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py.
justifications.fit: tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py:799-830 follows the file's idiom of literal expected command strings with a docstring stating why the case bites, and its names carry no plan, stage or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py:799-830 now asserts each review duty carries its own run's promotion command, which is the remedy shape the goal names; the behaviour itself landed at 96689ac036 and is not this commit's.
justifications.reuse: the commit adds no function, class or module; a search of tests/ for an existing promotion-command assertion found tests/test_crew_tool_carries_the_write_verbs.py:430 calls recovery_classification._promotion_command directly to test the builder, not a shared helper for rendered duty lines, so nothing is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat fc1f463060 lists exactly tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py, a path outside the fence whose out-of-scope write the manifest records under scope_note as coordinator-instructed.
